messages:
Martha Lee: Hey everyone — reminder that our Company Gathering is this Friday, Oct 11 at 11:00 PT (Zoom). Quick agenda: 1) Exec updates (10m) 2) Dedicated launch callout + migration notes (10m) 3) Policy update: data retention defaults (5m) 4) Live demo of new batching/runtime changes (10m) 5) AMA (15m). Please drop questions in this thread or add them to the intake form: https://forms.gle/example-intake. Recording will be posted to #all-hands-recordings and the Confluence page after the meeting. Slides due Thu EOD. RSVP via the calendar invite.


townhall-bot: Calendar invite sent to everyone — event on Oct 11 • 11:00 PT • Zoom • Add to your calendars: https://calendar.example.com/event/abcd (reminder in 24h and 1h)


Raj Patel: For the demo i'll show the continuous batching flow + latency numbers vs old runtime. Can we add 5m buffer for a quick rollback/mitigation walkthrough? would help eng folks who will be oncall.


Emily Chen: I'm assembling the slides now — will drop a draft link here once ready. Planning to add captions and speaker notes. Anyone needing accommodations, please DM me.


Jessica Gomez: Heads-up: we should include a short note about the Dedicated pricing change and migration path in the announcement. customers will want clarity. :point_up:


Martha Lee: Good call — ok we'll add one slide that highlights the pricing delta, migration steps, and support contact. @Raj please coordinate the migration checklist.


Eric Zhao: Quick legal question — does the retention policy change require customer opt-in or notice? Need to know copy for the slide.


Martha Lee: No opt-in required; this is an internal default change (retention default reduced to 30 days). Customers can continue to configure longer retention via the settings page. Legal & Security reviewed and approved the announcement language.


ProductOps: Collected Qs so far from team: scaling limits for Dedicated, RBAC granular permissions, audit log retention, Dedicated SLA. Recommend we prioritize RBAC and SLA in the AMA.


Raj Patel: noted. i'll prepare a short live script and a fallback plan. demo command i'll run locally to reproduce: `rdw demo --profile canary --max-tokens 512 --batching on`


Emily Chen: i'll add a short 'how to reproduce' appendix to the slide deck and link to the demo repo so others can run it later.


Jessica Gomez: Accessibility ask: can we enable Zoom auto-captions for the meeting and upload a VTT file alongside the recording? that would be great. :white_check_mark:


Martha Lee: Perfect — captions enabled and we'll upload VTT. Agenda locked. Final ask: please post final slides to this thread by Thu 5pm PT so ProductOps can stitch the recording timestamp guide. Thanks all!
